Important findings

The ten-episode limitation is confirmed in the ingestion code and has no historical paging path. Quick Actions support accessible reordering but cannot persist removal. Podcast search can use feed metadata and does not require transcripts.

Release relationship

Issue #833 is a 1.1 correctness blocker. Issues #834 and #835 are enhancements and are not automatically release blockers. The iCloud release gate remains #817.
